metadata.title: fix(tests): convert absolute URL paths to relative in Playwright tests for path-prefixed deployments
metadata.author: ChrisPC-39

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/4623

---

## 📝 Summary

Fixes Playwright test failures occurring when running against path-prefixed deployments (e.g., APP_ROOT_PATH="/test").

**Problem**: APIRequestContext resolves absolute URL paths (starting with `/`) from the domain root instead of from `base_url`, causing API calls to hit incorrect endpoints and return 404 errors.

**Solution**: Converted all absolute URL paths to relative paths in Playwright test files. When `base_url` contains a path prefix, relative URLs (without leading `/`) properly resolve from the configured base.

**Example changes**:
```python
# Before (breaks with path-prefixed base_url)
admin_api.post("/teams/")
api_request_context.get("/tools")
ctx.delete(f"/servers/{server_id}")

# After (works with any base_url structure)
admin_api.post("teams/")
api_request_context.get("tools")
ctx.delete(f"servers/{server_id}")
```
